lead: Ram Gopal Varma is an Indian film director, born on 7 April 1962 in Hyderabad.
As of 2026, he is 64 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Story and Nandi Award for Best Director.
This profile collects the Ram facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
